title: RED Agents and Capability Slots
markdown:
RED uses the Executive to route work to nine required specialists. The overlay replaces the generic specialist registry with this RED roster. The specialist tool enum and answer-source areas contain these nine names only.

| Key | Agent | Owns |
|---|---|---|
| `discovery` | Discovery and Diagnosis | Intake, diagnosis, avatar, unknowns |
| `ip_structuring` | IP Structuring | Signature Solution and milestones |
| `offer_journey` | Offer and Journey Design | Offer specification and customer path |
| `knowledge` | Knowledge Management | Ingestion, indexing, tenant-scoped retrieval |
| `governance` | Governance and Approval | Gate states, change impact, decision log |
| `asset_production` | Business Asset Production | Briefs and traced deliverables |
| `campaign_execution` | Campaign and Journey Execution | Implementation, launch checks, incidents |
| `insight` | Insight and Performance | Baseline, review, measured recommendation |
| `ip_portfolio` | IP Portfolio Development | Derivative opportunities and investment cases |

Capability slot 10, Client Success and Engagement Health, and slot 11, Assurance, Risk and Compliance, are chartered proposal-only roles. They are not registered as routable agents and have no execution permissions. They do not appear in the specialist tool enum.

Every specialist output is a proposal or an authorized internal action. Human approvers retain authority for substantive client decisions, publication, spend, and commitments.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  User[Request] --> Executive[RED Executive]
  Executive --> Roster[9 required specialists]
  Executive --> Slots[10 and 11: proposal-only]
  Roster --> Proposal[Draft or analysis]
  Slots --> Proposal
  Proposal --> Human[Human authority]
